intent: New original scenery atlases, generated from canon and observed project references.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for the original 2D side-view game ORDRE DE CENDRE, planet Kharon. Generate a NEW high-quality hand-painted realistic military science-fiction material atlas on a truly transparent RGBA background. One landscape sheet, exactly FOUR separate horizontal rectangular material slabs arranged as a clean 2-column by 2-row grid. No labels or text. Each slab fully visible, large, flat-front, rectangular, almost filling its cell but separated from every neighbor and canvas edge by generous fully transparent gutters. Within each rectangle, material fills the whole surface, opaque and continuous; no holes, objects, emblems or cutouts inside. The artwork will be sampled from the slab interiors and projected below an existing ground profile in a side-scrolling game, so use very shallow relief, consistent scale, no exaggerated perspective, no top-down diorama. Reading order: top-left dark cool graphite fractured basalt with compact horizontal strata and subdued grey edges; top-right tightly packed black volcanic scoria and small dull slag fragments, entirely cold and unlit; bottom-left ash-dusted refractory masonry with broad irregular grey-brown stone courses, worn mortar and fine black dust; bottom-right weathered matte graphite steel ground plates, narrow dark seams and subdued tarnished copper fasteners, no lights. Art direction: basalt, graphite, black dust, muted umber and tarnished copper, finely painted mineral grain, strong readable material character but restrained contrast. Match a smoky overcast basalt quarry and old copper foundry world. Neutral diffuse light, no dramatic cast shadows, no bright accents. VERY IMPORTANT: all four slabs are ordinary cold material and convey NO thermal danger or heat state. No lava, molten metal, glowing cracks, sparks, fire, steam, smoke, yellow warning stripes, heat lights, creatures, people, architecture, wheels, foliage, interface, border or watermark. Background and grid gutters must be true transparency, never a drawn checkerboard or white/black backdrop. The four pieces must not overlap. Aim for a clean 1536 by 1024 landscape atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production ground-scenery sprite atlas for the original 2D side-view game ORDRE DE CENDRE, planet Kharon. Generate a NEW finely hand-painted realistic military science-fiction sprite atlas with TRUE transparent RGBA background. One 1536 by 1024 landscape sheet, exactly SIX separate low ground decorations in a 3-column by 2-row equal grid. Each cell holds a single complete cutout, centered, with very generous fully transparent gutters on all sides and ample margin from neighboring cells. No labels, no frame, no text. Strict side-on view, a slight view of the top surface only; consistent light from upper left, diffuse overcast light, no perspective scene or diorama. Ground contact of each object is clearly along its lower edge. Each silhouette is wider than tall and must remain readable when drawn only about 32 units wide, so prioritize a simple mass and restrained small details. Reading order: top-left a low angular cluster of fractured dark basalt; top-middle a shallow compact pile of coarse black scoria gravel; top-right a low basalt stone with a subtle matte dusty sulphur mineral deposit in muted ochre, absolutely not glowing; bottom-left a low cooled basalt stone partly covered by a thin dark olive-grey scoria moss mat (FL11), no flowers and no glow; bottom-middle one short broad furnace fern clump (FL10), five or six dark charcoal-bronze fronds spreading low and outward, rooted in a tiny dark basal tuft; bottom-right a short discarded COLD tarnished copper pipe section lying horizontally, with one modest flange, dark empty ends and no valve, controls, markings or cables. Art direction: graphite, cool basalt, black dust, muted copper patina, sober painterly industrial world, weathering grounded in real materials. These are decorative scenery ONLY, no collectible, hazard or interactive prop cues. No lava, molten metal, hot orange cracks, light sources, warning stripes, steam, fumes, smoke, sparks, embers, animals, people, tall objects, ground plane, cast shadow outside silhouettes or interface. Plants do not bend to signal anything; all props are cold and static. Background and gutters must be actual transparent pixels, not painted black, white or checkerboard. Keep all six complete silhouettes isolated and fully inside their own cells.
